1.name: Making of a Maverick
1.ov: From humble beginnings to a Hollywood lifestyle, John DeLorean climbs the ranks at General Motors before deciding to launch a dazzling car of the future.

1.name: Bombs, Bullets & Bullsh*t
1.ov: As the DeLorean Motor Company sets up production in a volatile location, the turmoil outside its walls is rivaled only by the turbulence within.

1.name: Busted
1.ov: Major financial woes and explosive criminal charges put DMC in danger, and cause a major dent in John's carefully constructed image.
